screen: Choosing in the build — three ideas of how a part, a colour and a picture get chosen
job: Chapter 04 of the build, Parts & fit-out, mid-way on the Stacer 529 Assault Pro (Tournament, $28,530 Cash) with the Yamaha F115LB ($16,667) and the T Alloy 1400 skid braked trailer ($8,703): three parts on (Battery MFM50 $199, Garmin Striker Vivid 7cv $699, Safety Gear · Smooth Waters $83, total $54,881) and a fourth, the GME GX700W VHF radio ($249), in the hand. Each direction also draws the parts catalogue on its own (2,238 parts on sale, 197 with the maker's own picture, measured through src/domain/model/pictures.ts on 2026-10-30), the Highfield Sport 560's finish as colour and as the row's own picture (Hypalon $48,350, Black / White / Carbon), and a dealer adding their own picture to a part with its provenance. Every price is the Cash level of the manifest; no cost appears. The four parts the price list makes for this boat have no picture, and every board draws that honest empty state.

directions.name: A · The boat as the map
directions.axis: Found by where it goes: a side-on diagram of a boat in five places (bow, helm, deck, transom, trailer); a place lists the aisles Northside put there, and a part is dragged onto its place.
directions.only: Answers "what goes at the helm?" by pointing at the boat.

directions.name: A · the catalogue on the map, a finish, a dealer's picture
directions.axis: Parts & Accessories opened on its own on the same map, every aisle placed and counted; the Sport 560 finish as chips over the row's own render; Add a picture of the Battery MFM50.
directions.only: The catalogue is a map of the boat; unplaced aisles are counted, never hidden.

directions.name: B · The chandlery
directions.axis: Found by what it is for: 18 aisles in dealer words with drawings, the quote's boat held as a chip, tiles dragged into a tray that is the quote in printed order.
directions.only: The parts chapter is the catalogue: the same aisles inside a quote and on their own, learned once.

directions.name: B · the chandlery on its own, the finish aisle, a dealer's picture
directions.axis: All 18 aisles with measured counts and pictured counts; the finish pressed as colour with the render under it; Northside's own picture on its Safety Gear · Smooth Waters set.
directions.only: One chandlery in the main list and in the build.

directions.name: C · The printed quote, being pinned
directions.axis: Found by picture, chosen on the card: three weights (picture cards, ticked lines, counted bands) beside a live outline of the printed quote whose sections reorder or stay off by drag or by press.
directions.only: Builds the quote and its printed pages in one place.

directions.name: C · the catalogue in three weights, finishes as picture cards, a dealer's picture
directions.axis: Bands that state their count, picture cards inside; each Sport 560 colourway a card with its own render; the empty square on the Battery Box · Small card as the way to add a picture.
directions.only: Every card keeps its height, picture or not.
